t: You're on Romney Road, a street in the Royal Borough of Greenwich. It's named after Henry Sydney, the first Earl of Romney, who lived from 1641 to 1704. He was an army officer and Whig politician, and served as Master-General of the Ordnance from 1693 to 1702. He's best known as one of the Immortal Seven, who drafted the invitation to William of Orange that led to the Glorious Revolution of 1688.
